[[Gender/Legends|Mister]] '''Slarm''' was the first mate and assistant<ref name=":1">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> of the [[Starhunter's Intergalactic Menagerie]] under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Stroon]].

{{Char-stub}}

== Behind the scenes ==
Slarm made its first appearance in "[[Coby and the Starhunters]]", the ninth episode of the TV series [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO'']],<ref name=":0">{{DroidsCite|Coby and the Starhunters}}</ref> which first aired in [[November 2]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>

[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded|''A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded'']], ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and [[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia|''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] all described Slarm as a [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]]-like [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]],<ref name=":1" /><ref>''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref>{{CSWECite|III||Starhunter Intergalactic Menagerie}}</ref> despite him appearing as a [[Human]] in the TV episode.<ref name=":0" />
